id_policy: Proposed IDs extend the client catalog; allocation and package versioning require review.
type_syntax: WIT value types; null means no result. Types below are records and enums are named WIT enums.
argument_convention: For each hook or service, generate one named input record from a nonempty arguments map, or no parameter for an empty map. Sort record fields by WIT field name, independent of JSON object order; null result means no return value.

identity.player: Canonical UUID string; not a username or an entity handle.
identity.entity: Proposed opaque u32 handle scoped to the open world epoch; valid across hooks and ticks until the entity is removed, changes dimension, or the world closes. Native zero sentinels for absent entities map to none at the ABI boundary; present entities map to some(handle). Handles from earlier epochs must never resolve.
identity.block_entity: Opaque u32 handle to an in-flight block entity, valid only during its callback. It is not an entity handle.

failure_policy: Fail closed for host operations. A failed listen contributes nothing; a failed collect preserves the current aggregate; a failed cancel does not add a cancellation; a failed mutate preserves the current value. Earlier successful host operations are not rolled back.
chat_recipients_semantics: When all is true, only is ignored; otherwise only is the exact UUID allowlist, including an empty list.

hooks.name: register_commands
hooks.fallback: Contribute no commands; retain earlier registrations.

hooks.name: perform_command
hooks.fallback: Do not claim or cancel the command.

hooks.name: server_tick
hooks.phase: server tick start/end, including whether a world is running

hooks.name: world_lifecycle
hooks.fallback: Skip this callback; invalidate handles on close regardless.

hooks.name: block_entity
hooks.rationale: A host-created typed entity starts with an empty compound; ownership and compatibility with other constructors need review.

hooks.name: block_entity_ticks
hooks.composition: OR the result with the current ticks value; false never clears an earlier true.
hooks.rationale: Ticker selection changes live block entity behavior and must compose with earlier hooks.

hooks.name: block_entity_tick
hooks.phase: block entity tick, while the entity is in flight
hooks.fallback: Apply no additional changes; preserve already successful host operations.
hooks.rationale: Typed synchronous operations must target the borrowed in-flight entity and preserve other NBT fields and sync ordering.

hooks.name: block_entity_update_tag
hooks.thread: server or snapshot worker; no host imports
hooks.operation: True requests a host-side copy of the complete current native NBT into the update tag; false preserves the current aggregate.
hooks.rationale: The copy must preserve unknown NBT and work safely on the server and snapshot worker without live host imports.

hooks.name: net_from_client
hooks.fallback: Drop the mod packet without changing vanilla packet handling.

hooks.name: server_chat_listened
hooks.fallback: Contribute false; preserve any earlier true.

hooks.name: server_chat
hooks.composition: A returned cancellation only adds cancellation; other fields replace the current values in dispatch order.
hooks.fallback: Preserve current message, recipients, system flag and cancellation state.
hooks.rationale: Recipient and cancellation changes must compose with earlier chat hooks without widening delivery on failure.

hooks.name: attack_entity
hooks.rationale: Existing dispatch covers LAN guests; confirm or add an equivalent authoritative local-player path.

hooks.name: living_incoming_damage
hooks.phase: before applying damage, with borrowed damage context
hooks.fallback: Preserve current damage and do not add cancellation.
hooks.rationale: Damage mutation and cancellation must compose in native order without reentering the borrowed entity.

hooks.name: living_knockback
hooks.phase: before applying knockback, with borrowed damage context
hooks.fallback: Preserve current knockback and do not add cancellation.
hooks.rationale: Knockback mutation and cancellation must compose without reentering borrowed state.

hooks.name: hears_projectile_impacts
hooks.fallback: Contribute false; preserve any earlier true.

hooks.name: player_input
hooks.rationale: Existing dispatch covers LAN guests; confirm or add equivalent authoritative host/local input dispatch.

hooks.name: use_item
hooks.rationale: Specify a lossless, bounded representation for item components without exposing the live stack.

hooks.name: interact_entity
hooks.rationale: Specify a lossless, bounded representation for item components without exposing the live stack.

services.name: acting_player
services.fallback: No acting player; caller skips player-specific action.

services.name: held
services.rationale: The engine must snapshot a live inventory and define item-component encoding.

services.name: server_players
services.fallback: Return an error rather than a misleading partial player list.
services.rationale: Define limits and consistent enumeration without silently truncating players.

services.name: entities_in
services.fallback: Return an error and no entity results.
services.rationale: Specify bounded query limits, snapshot fields and entity handle lifetime.

services.name: clip
services.fallback: Return an error; do not treat failure as a clear ray.
services.rationale: Define loaded-chunk, collision-shape and fluid handling to match native clipping.

services.name: player_stacks
services.fallback: Return an error and no partial inventory snapshot.
services.rationale: Live inventories require a bounded, slot-preserving snapshot and a lossless item-component representation.

services.name: player_teleport
services.fallback: On immediate rejection, do not initiate teleport.
services.completion: Ok means accepted, not that cross-dimension travel completed; late failures do not roll back earlier successful operations.
services.rationale: Define unloaded destination, asynchronous completion and cross-dimension failure semantics before allowing teleportation.

services.name: player_clear_inventory
services.rationale: Clearing a live inventory requires atomicity and explicit slot and cursor semantics.

services.name: player_effect_clear
services.rationale: Confirm whether an absent effect clears all effects and how native duration flags map.

services.name: player_attribute_modifier_remove
services.rationale: Confirm modifier identifier encoding and whether it is a UUID or resource identifier.

services.name: player_play_sound
services.rationale: Define valid sound categories and the seed mapping for targeted playback.

services.name: bossbar_create
services.rationale: Define namespacing, ownership and cleanup of stable resource-identifier bossbars.

services.name: run_command
services.fallback: Do not execute the command; use typed operations when available.
services.rationale: An unrestricted command interpreter requires an explicit owner security decision and is not proposed for 1.1.

services.name: block
services.fallback: Return an error; do not invent a block.

services.name: block_property
services.fallback: Return an error; do not invent a property.

services.name: set_block_property
services.rationale: Specify accepted properties and flags, update notifications, chunk availability and authority.

services.name: block_collision
services.fallback: Return an error rather than treating the block as empty.
services.rationale: Confirm box coordinate space, unloaded-chunk behavior and snapshot consistency.

services.name: edit_blocks
services.fallback: Reject invalid edits without applying them.
services.rationale: Specify validation, limits, palette identifiers, unloaded cells, notifications and partial-success semantics.

services.name: block_entity_sync
services.rationale: Define when a committed state is saved, marked dirty and broadcast.

services.name: block_entity_read
services.fallback: Return an error without exposing a live object.
services.rationale: Define schema and serialization for mod-owned fields without exposing live NBT.

services.name: block_entity_patch
services.rationale: Apply typed field updates while preserving unrecognized NBT and avoiding live object references.

services.name: spawn_mannequin
services.rationale: Specify permitted poses, copied player appearance and the lifetime of the returned entity handle.

services.name: remove_spawned_entity
services.rationale: Limit removal to authorized entities and define ownership and stale-handle behavior.

services.name: net_send_to_player
services.rationale: Namespace channels and bound payload size and per-player send rate.

services.name: world_dir
services.fallback: Do not expose a host filesystem path; use world-storage operations.
services.rationale: Ambient host filesystem paths cannot be safely exposed to untrusted components.

services.name: config_dir
services.fallback: Do not expose a host filesystem path; use config-storage operations.
services.rationale: The native configuration path needs a scoped storage interface instead of ambient filesystem access.

services.name: world_storage_read
services.fallback: Return an error, not empty saved state, on I/O failure.
services.rationale: Define world and mod namespacing, migration, quotas and open-world lifecycle.

services.name: world_storage_write
services.rationale: Define atomic replacement, persistence timing, size limits and recovery after failure.

services.name: config_read
services.fallback: Return an error on I/O failure; only a missing value may use packaged defaults.
services.rationale: Specify mod-owned configuration scope, size limits and packaged-default precedence.

services.name: config_write
services.rationale: Specify permitted files, atomic writes and whether server policy allows config mutation.

services.name: asset_read
services.fallback: Return no asset when absent, or an error on read failure.
services.rationale: Define read-only component asset packaging and interaction with map configuration overrides.

services.name: inventory_apply
services.fallback: Leave the inventory unchanged; the caller may retry.
services.rationale: Replace give/clear commands with typed changes; preserve item components, count, full-inventory drops and retry semantics.

services.name: team_apply
services.fallback: Leave teams unchanged; the caller may retry.
services.rationale: Replace scoreboard commands with scoped operations and define membership, properties and ownership.

services.name: world_control
services.fallback: Leave world settings and force-loaded chunks unchanged.
services.rationale: Replace time, gamerule and force-load commands; define dimensions, authority, cleanup and allowed rules.

services.name: particle_spawn
services.rationale: Specify particle identifiers and options, recipient defaults, visibility and rate limits.

services.name: range_override_set
services.rationale: Nestgate voice integration and ownership/composition of range overrides require the W5 owner decision.

services.name: range_override_clear
services.rationale: W5 must define cleanup and interactions with other owners' voice overrides.

services.name: qa_mode_enabled
services.fallback: Return false and leave QA-only behavior disabled.
services.rationale: Replace the native environment switch with host opt-in; define authorization and visibility of QA-only commands.

services.name: qa_record
services.fallback: Discard diagnostics on failure without affecting gameplay.
services.rationale: Replace arbitrary path appends with scoped logging; define privacy, retention and buffering from host-free callbacks.
